name: Airbridge
description: Airbridge bridges DLNA/UPnP audio streams to AirPlay (RAOP) devices. Creates virtual DLNA renderers that forward audio to AirPlay speakers, allowing media servers like Music Assistant or Plex to stream to AirPlay-only devices through DLNA. Features: - Virtual DLNA renderer per AirPlay zone - Automatic AirPlay device discovery (mDNS) - Web admin interface for managing devices - Volume control support Requires host network mode for mDNS device discovery and SSDP announcements.
